title: Key word transformations (C1) 1
summary_es: Seis frases: oraciones escindidas, «be about to», «wish», «chance of», colocaciones y present perfect continuo.

items.original: I didn't realise how much she had helped me until she left.
items.after: I realised how much she had helped me.
items.explanation_es: Oración escindida de énfasis: It was only when/after… that… Destaca el momento.

items.original: We were on the point of leaving when the phone rang.
items.explanation_es: «Be on the point of -ing» = «be about to + infinitivo»: estar a punto de.

items.original: It's a pity I didn't take your advice.
items.explanation_es: Arrepentimiento sobre el pasado: wish + past perfect.

items.original: The manager is unlikely to approve the plan.
items.explanation_es: «There is little chance of someone doing something»: tras of, el sujeto y el verbo en -ing.

items.original: Nobody could have predicted that the company would collapse.
items.explanation_es: Colocación: «come as a surprise / a shock to someone».

items.original: She started working here ten years ago.
items.explanation_es: Acción que empezó en el pasado y continúa: present perfect continuo + for + duración.
